title: Collect every VCF Installer task page through VCF PowerCLI
prompt:
Implement the exported `Get-VcfInstallerTaskInventory` function in `src/VcfInstaller.TaskInventory/VcfInstaller.TaskInventory.psm1`.

Before implementing, research the VCF Installer 9.1 `getTasks` operation and its generated VMware VCF PowerCLI binding in official VMware sources. Cite the sources consulted in the final answer.

Use the prerequisite `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer` PowerCLI module. Starting at `pageNumber` 0, retrieve every page using `Invoke-VcfInstallerGetTasks`, follow `PageMetadata.TotalPages`, and return all task objects ordered by `CreationTimestamp` ascending and then `Id` ascending. Always send `pageNumber` and `pageSize`; `PageSize` defaults to 100 and must be 1 through 100. Forward `TaskStatus`, `TaskType`, `ResourceId`, `ResourceType`, `CompletedAfter`, `TaskName`, and `DoLiveRefresh` only when the caller actually bound that parameter. An unset filter must be omitted from the SDK invocation and therefore from the request, including `doLiveRefresh` despite its OpenAPI default. Pass the supplied connected VCF Installer Server object to every SDK call. Reject missing page metadata and inconsistent page numbers rather than silently returning a partial collection.

Do not use `Invoke-RestMethod`, `Invoke-WebRequest`, `WebClient`, `HttpClient`, curl, or another direct HTTP client. Keep the public command and manifest in place. Run `python3 tests/verify.py`.
